regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, graphical abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate nickel-catalyzed reductive 1,4-arylalkylation claim. The graphical abstract summarizes the current reaction class rather than an experiment-specific run.

regions.region: page 1 Figure 1 and introduction
regions.finding: Figure 1 is a generic comparison of conventional 1,2-difunctionalization/central chirality and underexplored 1,4-difunctionalization/axial chirality. It is classified as a general scheme, not a current experimental run.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right prior-work discussion continued to Figure 2
regions.finding: The Bao/Zhang, Liu, and Wang routes are cited prior work. Their generic reaction classes are represented as literature examples and are not assigned current-paper table yields.

unresolved: Figure 1 and the graphical abstract use generic/stylized structures and do not define unique molecules, quantities, conditions, or outcomes.
The publisher SI link does not establish a workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Figure 2a representative molecules/catalysts
regions.finding: Representative natural products and chiral catalysts are context objects, not reaction experiments on this page; no records were fabricated for their syntheses.

regions.region: page 2 left Figure 2b prior routes and Figure 2c current design
regions.finding: Separated two cited prior-work reaction classes from the current generic nickel-catalyzed cross-electrophile design. None is assigned a Table 1 outcome.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–12, ligand structures, and footnotes
regions.finding: All 12 optimization rows were retained independently with shared charges/conditions, row ligand/reductant/aryl-halide/loading/temperature/solvent deviations, GC or qualitative outcomes, isolated entry-1 yield, ee/ND, and analytical bases. Entry 8 remains one grouped three-omission source row.

regions.region: page 2 Results and Discussion prose
regions.finding: The prose maps optimization observations to Table 1 and introduces Table 2; no narrative duplicates were created.

unresolved: Table 1 omits reaction time, atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses.
Entry 8 groups three omission controls and does not provide separable row outcomes.
Scheme 1 uses the page-2/3 standard-condition definition but omits several operation details.

regions.region: page 3 Table 2 header and Scope A aryl-halide rows
regions.finding: Recorded 20 distinct Scope-A experiments: 4a–4r plus separate L1*/ent-L1* 4s lines. Shared quantities, isolated-yield/average-two-run basis, chiral-HPLC ee values, footnote-c aryl-iodide substitutions, and product-specific dr values were retained.

regions.region: page 3 Table 2 Scope B 1,3-enyne rows
regions.finding: Recorded all 13 1,3-enyne scope products 5a–5m with isolated yields and ee. X-ray/CCDC 2350387 for 5a is characterization provenance, not a second preparation or SI association.

regions.region: page 3 Table 2 Scope C alkyl-iodide rows
regions.finding: Recorded all 16 alkyl-iodide rows 6a–6p. Footnote-d conditions were applied to 6j–6o and footnote-e conditions to 6p. The 6o 1:1 dr and two displayed ee values remain separate outcomes.

regions.region: page 3 Table 2 caption and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Applied 0.20 mmol/average-of-two-runs scope metadata, isolated-purified yield basis, chiral-HPLC ee basis, and row-specific c/d/e reagent/condition overrides. Reaction times were not inferred.

regions.region: page 3 lower scope discussion
regions.finding: Mapped functional-group and stereochemical discussion to the displayed Table 2 rows without creating summary duplicates; the prose introduces the page-4 mechanistic experiments.

unresolved: Table 2 omits reaction time, atmosphere, workup, detailed purification, and isolated masses.
Compact scope structures remain source-labeled where safe stereochemical encoding was uncertain.
The two 6o ee values are not named by diastereomer in the source.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 1a gram-scale arrow
regions.finding: Recorded the independent 5.0 mmol bench-top 4a scale-up with 1.15 g product, 62% yield, and 90% ee under standard conditions.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 1b–e control arrows
regions.finding: Recorded four distinct controls: TEMPO trapping (4a 29%, 92% ee plus HRMS-detected trapped products), 2n radical clock (5n 32%), stereospecific 3q probe (6q 56%, 1:1 dr, 93%/92% ee), and MeOH trapping (4a 15%, 92% ee; 7a 45%).

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 1f six kinetic plots
regions.finding: Recorded six separate concentration series for catalyst, NaI, Zn, aryl bromide 1a, alkyl iodide 3a, and enyne 2a. Printed regressions and stated order interpretations were retained; graph points were not estimated.

regions.region: page 4 two-column mechanistic discussion
regions.finding: Linked narrative interpretations to the five control arrows and six kinetic series. SI section 6.1 was not associated or imported.

unresolved: Scheme 1a–e omit reaction times, atmosphere, workups, purifications, and several measurement bases.
The TEMPO-trapped structures/yields occur only in unassociated SI.
Kinetic point values and independent ligand-order data are not tabulated on pages 1–6.

regions.region: page 5 left Figure 3 and mechanistic prose
regions.finding: Classified the I–VIII nickel/radical relay cycle as a proposed mechanism. Intermediates and radicals are not isolated preparations and carry no experimental yields.

regions.region: page 5 Conclusions
regions.finding: Aggregate conclusions restate the developed reaction and radical pathway but add no experiment-specific row, quantity, or outcome.

regions.region: page 5 Associated Content, author information, acknowledgments, and beginning of references
regions.finding: Administrative/bibliographic material only. The paper advertises online experimental procedures and a 5a CIF, but workspace SI association remains unestablished; no SI fact was inferred.

unresolved: Proposed intermediates have no independent observation status or quantities.
The online SI/CIF statement does not establish a workspace SI association or machine structure verification.

regions.region: page 6 full two-column references 1–6 and continuation
regions.finding: The original rendered page contains bibliography/prior-literature citations only. No current-paper reaction arrow, table, procedure, quantity, outcome, failure, footnote reagent, or characterization mapping occurs on this page; external cited experiments were not imported as records of this article.

unresolved: No current-paper reaction experiment or record enrichment occurs on this page.
Referenced external experiments were not re-extracted as records of this article.
